title: Fix a rejected session
description: A touch panel refused its console login, so the node stopped dialing it. Read why, point the endpoint at the rotated credential, and watch the session come up.

steps.caption: This place's system. Its touch panel fills no role, but a node collects it.
Expand it to the component's view, where collection is read.
It reads rejected, in the panel's own words; the node stopped dialing, so nothing locks out.
Open the endpoint. The ladder shows the ping and the transport answering, and the login held.
The credential is one of the endpoint's inputs, edited in place.
Point the login at the secret holding the rotated password.
Save. What the endpoint connects with changed, so the refusal no longer holds.
The node logs in at its next check-in, and the session reads up.
